open_points.subject: RECORDS BUILT FOR THIS MODULE and final model-mutation instruction
open_points.text:
Constructing such a record here — its constructor, model_construct, model_validate,
or model_copy of a parameter of that type — is rejected (record_construction_bypassed).
open_points.other_text: Never assign to an attribute of a model value (models are frozen): derive a changed value with value.model_copy(update={...}) or construct a new instance.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must listed records always be changed through their imported builders, or may this module use model_copy or direct construction?

open_points.subject: authenticate_staff dependency note
open_points.text: a failure rolls back with PortalTransaction.rollback only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
open_points.rule:

микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted method reference with classified behavioral prose requiring the open transaction to be rolled back before the original failure is re-raised.

open_points.subject: change_staff_status audit-selection note
open_points.text: change_staff_status: [BEHAVIOR] MUST append exactly one audit, its intent built with the imported build_staff_audit_intent, passing as action the member chosen by the target status — the staff.suspend member of = models.AuditAction, its staff.disable member, or its staff.reinstate member for either transition into active — as entity_kind the STAFF_ACCOUNT member of = models.AuditEntityKind, as entity_id that staff_id and as project_id None. Suspension and disabling MUST additionally revoke every session of that account that is neither revoked nor expired, each replaced with the imported revise_staff_session at the same instant as revoked_at, because suspending or disabling an account ends its sessions; the account has nothing else to revoke.
open_points.rule:
Таблица — это когда по
  члену перечисления выбирается значение: член другого перечисления, код,
  категория. Такое соответствие — само значение, таблица соответствий, даже
  когда оно сводится к «один член — одно, остальные — другое»; подмножество
  членов, задающее категорию, — allow-list. Код читает их как константу
  поставщика данных (§15.3.1, §6.10), а не как прозу рядом с `= models.X`.
open_points.question: Move the target-status-to-audit-action mapping and the suspension-or-disabling category into imported provider constants, and make the note name those imported constants.
